Engineering & Technology

What Makes WPC Doors Different

Three built-in technologies standard across the entire range — not optional add-ons.

🔒
PUR Edge Banding Technology
Polyurethane reactive adhesive creates a super-strong, moisture-resistant bond at all four door edges. No cracking, no peeling — even across UAE humidity cycles. Seamless finish on every edge.
🔄
Invisible Hinge System (SW-001)
Fully concealed hinge rated to 80KG per door leaf on three hinges. No visible hardware. Clean architectural finish that developers and interior designers specify for premium UAE projects.
🚫
Door Bottom Lift & Seal Strip
Auto-activating bottom seal rises when door opens, drops flush on close. Reduces sound, blocks desert dust, prevents pest entry — three UAE-specific problems solved passively.

Why WPC for the UAE

Why Specify WPC Doors on UAE Projects

Traditional timber and MDF doors face real problems in the UAE. WPC is engineered to solve them.

🌡️
Heat & Humidity Resistant
WPC doesn't swell, warp, or crack in UAE summer conditions — maintaining a perfect fit and finish year-round, unlike solid timber or MDF.
🌿
Zero Formaldehyde
Meets green building standards required by UAE master developers, Estidama ratings, and international hospitality brand specifications.
🐛
Pest & Termite Proof
WPC composite offers no food source for termites or moths — zero infestation risk without ongoing chemical treatment.
🔇
Sound & Dust Sealing
Auto-seal bottom strip and WPC's density reduce sound transmission and block desert dust — two daily complaints in UAE residential projects solved by design.
🎨
40+ Models, One Supplier
Invisible, minimalist, and luxury collections cover every door in a full development — from lobby to bedroom — from one VAT-registered UAE supplier.
📄
UAE Procurement Ready
Trade licence, VAT certificate, share register, and full tax invoices for vendor registration. 24hr quote turnaround. Delivery across all emirates.
